limitations: CPU is bounded by Pi's native QuickJS interrupt-poll budget. It is not a measured two-second operating-system CPU quota as in v8-exec.
OpenAPI binary and multipart request bodies still require the platform file-transport integration.
Remote source discovery failures are isolated from the other tools and visible as an unavailable catalog entry; refresh depends on the agent configuration/source refresh integration.
